description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseDosingInstructions' implementing the 'DosingInstructions' interface. It provides a method to calculate an auto-expire date for drug orders based on duration and units, and includes a helper method to adjust dates. The class is part of the 'org.openmrs' package, used in the OpenMRS medical record system.

classes.name: BaseDosingInstructions
classes.description: Abstract class implementing dosing instructions with logic for calculating auto-expire dates for drug orders.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Calculates the auto-expire date of a drug order based on its duration, duration units, and start date.

methods.name: aMomentBefore
methods.description: Helper method that returns a date one second before the given date.
